<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915410_theRebbe_669" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915410_theRebbe_669__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the ninth of Kislev, the birthday and yahrtzeit of the Mitteler Rebbe, serves as the preparation for the tenth of Kislev, the day of redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And it is known,</t>
    <t s="2">that Shabbos and Yom Tov require preparation on the day preceding them — Erev Shabbos and Erev Yom Tov.</t>
    <t s="3">And regarding our matter,</t>
    <t s="4">the Festival of Redemption, the tenth of Kislev — the eve of the tenth of Kislev</t>
    <t s="5">[in which is the preparation for the tenth of Kislev]</t>
    <t s="6">is the ninth of Kislev,</t>
    <t s="7">the birthday and the yahrtzeit of the Baal HaGeulah (Master of the Redemption).</t>
    <t s="8">And although the redemption of the tenth of Kislev was in the year 5587,</t>
    <t s="9">a year before the passing,</t>
    <t s="10">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="11">since they roll a merit to a worthy day,</t>
    <t s="12">it must be said,</t>
    <t s="13">that the fact that the ninth of Kislev merited to be the yahrtzeit of the Mitteler Rebbe is because even before this it was related to this.</t>
    <t s="14">And based on this it must be said,</t>
    <t s="15">that the greatness of the elevation of the day of redemption</t>
    <t s="16">[the tenth of Kislev],</t>
    <t s="17">that the matter of “He redeemed my soul in peace” within it is in the manner of the matter of “He redeemed my soul in peace” that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="18">is because its “eve” is the yahrtzeit of the Baal HaGeulah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the souls above are called “standing,” and only through descending into this world do they become “going,” achieving an infinite ascent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by prefacing what the Baal HaGeulah said in his maamar beginning “To understand the matter of the Hilula of Rashbi,”</t>
    <t s="2">that the fact that the day of the passing of Rashbi is called by the name “Hilula,”</t>
    <t s="3">is,</t>
    <t s="4">because through Rashbi there was the revelation of the inner dimension of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="5">And he explains this by prefacing the saying of our sages of blessed memory,</t>
    <t s="6">“This world from which we depart is like a wedding,”</t>
    <t s="7">that through the descent of the souls below into this world,</t>
    <t s="8">this world,</t>
    <t s="9">there is brought about in them the matter of “we depart,”</t>
    <t s="10">“going.”</t>
    <t s="11">For the souls as they are above are called “standing,” as it is said,</t>
    <t s="12">“As the L-rd G-d of Israel lives, before Whom I have stood,”</t>
    <t s="13">and in the Zohar it is stated,</t>
    <t s="14">“Every single soul stands in its image before the Holy King.”</t>
    <t s="15">For although the souls as they are above are constantly in ratzo v’shov (running and returning),</t>
    <t s="16">through which they ascend in elevation after elevation,</t>
    <t s="17">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="18">since all their ascents are within limitation,</t>
    <t s="19">for even the highest levels</t>
    <t s="20">(in which is the ascent of the souls)</t>
    <t s="21">are according to the measure of the line of measurement,</t>
    <t s="22">therefore they are called “standing.”</t>
    <t s="23">And through the descent of the souls below, they become “going,”</t>
    <t s="24">for the ascent of the souls in their descent below is in the aspect of Ein Sof and without limit.</t>
    <t s="25">And this is “this world from which we depart,”</t>
    <t s="26">that the souls as they are in their own essence are “standing,”</t>
    <t s="27">and through their descent into this world,</t>
    <t s="28">they become “going,”</t>
    <t s="29">“we depart.”</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the union of soul and body in this world is like a wedding, drawing down the infinite power of Ein Sof, which is revealed through the offspring of good deeds.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the reason for this, that specifically through this world the matter of “we depart” is brought about,</t>
    <t s="1">is,</t>
    <t s="2">because “this world is like a wedding.”</t>
    <t s="3">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="4">that soul and body are analogous to a man and a woman.</t>
    <t s="5">And just as with a man and a woman in their simple sense,</t>
    <t s="6">in order for there to be the union of male and female</t>
    <t s="7">(which are two opposites),</t>
    <t s="8">it is through the drawing down of the power of Ein Sof that is above both of them,</t>
    <t s="9">and this power that is drawn into them is revealed in the matter of procreation</t>
    <t s="10">[for the matter of begetting generation after generation without measure is not from the aspect of the limitation of created beings, who are finite,</t>
    <t s="11">but from the aspect of the power of Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="12">that is above the limitation of created beings</t>
    <t s="13">that is drawn down through marriage],</t>
    <t s="14">so too is it with soul and body, which are analogous to a man and a woman,</t>
    <t s="15">that in order for there to be the connection and union of soul and body, which are two opposites, it is through the drawing down of the power of Ein Sof.</t>
    <t s="16">And the drawing down of this power is revealed in the matter of procreation,</t>
    <t s="17">“the offspring of the righteous are good deeds,”</t>
    <t s="18">for the ascent through Torah and mitzvos is an ascent in the aspect of Ein Sof and without limit.</t>
    <t s="19">And this is “this world from which we depart is like a wedding,”</t>
    <t s="20">for the reason for this, that specifically from it</t>
    <t s="21">(this world)</t>
    <t s="22">there is brought about “we depart”</t>
    <t s="23">(“going”),</t>
    <t s="24">is,</t>
    <t s="25">because “this world is like a wedding,”</t>
    <t s="26">that the connection and union of the spiritual soul with the physical body</t>
    <t s="27">(this world)</t>
    <t s="28">is analogous to the union of a groom and bride</t>
    <t s="29">(Hilula,</t>
    <t s="30">wedding),</t>
    <t s="31">through which the power of Ein Sof is drawn down.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
